title: Week 8 Cheat Sheet: Heterogeneous Graphs & RGCN

items.label: Heterogeneous graph
items.note: $G=(V,E,\tau,\phi)$; relation type = (node_start, edge, node_end). 2 node × 2 edge types = 8 relation types.

items.label: Types vs features
items.note: One-hot types reduce to homogeneous; true heterogeneity needed for different feature shapes or relation-specific models.

items.label: RGCN
items.note: One $W_r$ per relation, normalise per relation, plus self term.

items.label: Parameter growth
items.note: Each relation has $L$ matrices of size $d^{(l+1)}\times d^{(l)}$: grows with $|R|$, overfitting.

items.label: Block-diagonal
items.note: $B$ blocks cut parameters to $d^{(l+1)}d^{(l)}/B$; no cross-block interaction.

items.label: Basis learning
items.note: Shared bases $V_b$, per-relation coefficients; large savings when $B\ll|R|$.

items.label: Link prediction
items.note: Score $h_E^\top W_rh_A$; negatives by perturbing the supervision edge (not training edges); CE loss.

items.label: Ranking metrics
items.note: Hits@k and reciprocal rank (higher is better).

items.label: Heterogeneous GNN design
items.note: Per-relation message; AGG within then across relations; per-type MLPs; sampling per relation or global; type-specific heads.
